# Device-Free Localization

Estimate the location of a person or object that does not carry or actively operate the wireless device producing the measurements.

**Datasets in catalogue:** 5

| Dataset | Inputs | Targets | Origin | Environment | Mobility | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Occluded Indoor Target mmWave Tracking Dataset](../datasets/occluded-mmwave-target-tracking.md) | Radar | Position | Measurement | Indoor | Not applicable | Registration required |
| [OPERAnet](../datasets/operanet.md) | Wi-Fi CSI | Position | Measurement | Indoor | Mixed | Open |
| [Sub-GHz Device-Free Localization Dataset](../datasets/subghz-device-free-localization.md) | RSS | Position | Measurement | Indoor, Office | Not applicable | Open |
| [UWB Non-Cooperative Contextual Sensing Dataset](../datasets/uwb-noncooperative-contextual-sensing.md) | Channel impulse response | Position | Measurement | Indoor, Residential | Not applicable | Open |
| [WiMANS](../datasets/wimans.md) | Wi-Fi CSI | Position | Measurement | Indoor | Not applicable | Registration required |
